# Device end-to-end. Skips when ANDROID_HOME unset / no AVD / adb missing.

[!android-jdk] skip 'no JDK in the range the Android toolchain supports'
[!android-sdk] skip 'ANDROID_HOME / ANDROID_SDK_ROOT not set'
[!exec:adb] skip 'adb required'
[!exec:emulator] skip 'emulator required'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=device app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { kotlin { android } }

component counter {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testStartsAtZero(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}
